problem.passage:
In the figure, line $m$ is parallel to line $n$. Two transversals, line $j$ and line $k$, intersect line $m$ and then meet each other at point $E$, which lies below line $m$ (on the opposite side of line $m$ from line $n$). Line $j$ intersects line $m$ at point $A$, and line $k$ intersects line $m$ at point $B$, so that triangle $ABE$ is formed with vertices $A$, $B$, and $E$. The interior angle of triangle $ABE$ at vertex $A$ (between side $AB$, which lies along line $m$, and side $AE$, which lies along line $j$) measures $52°$. The interior angle of triangle $ABE$ at vertex $B$ (between side $AB$ and side $BE$, which lies along line $k$) measures $71°$. The angle marked $x°$ is the interior angle of triangle $ABE$ at vertex $E$.

What is the value of $x$?
problem.stimulus: In the figure, line $m$ is parallel to line $n$. Two transversals, line $j$ and line $k$, intersect line $m$ and then meet each other at point $E$, which lies below line $m$ (on the opposite side of line $m$ from line $n$). Line $j$ intersects line $m$ at point $A$, and line $k$ intersects line $m$ at point $B$, so that triangle $ABE$ is formed with vertices $A$, $B$, and $E$. The interior angle of triangle $ABE$ at vertex $A$ (between side $AB$, which lies along line $m$, and side $AE$, which lies along line $j$) measures $52°$. The interior angle of triangle $ABE$ at vertex $B$ (between side $AB$ and side $BE$, which lies along line $k$) measures $71°$. The angle marked $x°$ is the interior angle of triangle $ABE$ at vertex $E$.
problem.question: What is the value of $x$?
problem.explanation:
삼각형 $ABE$의 세 내각은 꼭짓점 $A$, $B$, $E$에서의 각으로, 각각 $52°$, $71°$, $x°$이다. 삼각형의 내각의 합은 $180°$이므로 $52 + 71 + x = 180$이다. 따라서 $x = 180 - 52 - 71 = 57$이다.

(참고: 만약 두 각 $52°$와 $71°$을 평행선 성질에 의해 단순히 서로 엇각 등으로 잘못 대응시켜 $x = 52 + 71 = 123$으로 계산하면 핵심 관계인 '삼각형의 내각의 합이 $180°$'라는 사실을 놓치게 되어 오답이 나온다.)

정답: $x = 57$

difficultyReasons: 삼각형 내각의 합이 180도라는 단일 공식 적용만 필요함
평행선 정보는 문제 풀이에 실제로 필요하지 않은 배경 설명(방해 정보)임
계산은 180-52-71의 단순 뺄셈 한 단계로 끝남
